nodes.label: CodeQL Triage Process & False-Positive Catalog
nodes.rationale: Documents six confirmed false-positives (name-heuristic password, incompatible-types typeof/null, URL substring-sanitization in test mock, Bun.SQL tagged-template null-cast, build-time extension seam trivial-conditional, two official dismissals) plus a pattern where unused-local-variable in tests sometimes flags a real coverage gap; suppression comments are documented as ineffective in this repo's CI (PR #505/#496).
